q: A first grader says, "Our class has 12 desks." Which is a fact that can be checked by counting?
o: There are 12 desks in the room.
e: A fact can be proven with evidence.

q: You want to learn what a firefighter does. Which is a good oral source?
o: asking a firefighter who visits the class
e: Talking to a real person who does the job is a valid source.

q: After a class trip to a farm, which shows what you learned in a picture?
e: You can communicate learning by drawing.

q: While a classmate is speaking during circle time, you should...
o: look at them and wait your turn

q: A second grader reads that a town has one library. Which statement is a fact?
o: The library is the prettiest building.
It is the best place ever.
e: Facts can be shown with evidence.

q: After studying your neighborhood, which way could you share what you learned in writing?
o: write a short paragraph about it
e: Writing is one way to communicate information.

q: What is a good rule when a classmate is answering a question?
o: raise your hand and listen quietly
e: Respectful listening is a classroom procedure.

q: You studied a map of your town and want to share it. Which way is speaking aloud?
o: giving a short talk about the map

q: Which is a picture-based way to show where places are in your school?
o: draw a map of the school
write a long poem about lunch

q: Which is the title of the official state song of Texas?
e: Texas, Our Texas is the state song.

q: You researched the Alamo for a project. How can you show your ideas aloud?
Which of these is a written product a student could make after Texas research?
o: a journal entry written as a settler
e: Journal entries and reports are written material.

q: Which shows the benefit of free enterprise to a shopper?
o: several stores compete, so shoppers find lower prices
only one store sets any price
e: Competition gives customers choice and better prices.

q: After research on the Constitution, a student presents findings to the class. This is...
A student makes an outline, a timeline, and a report about the Revolution. These are examples of...
e: Outlines and reports are student-created material.

q: In a class debate on whether to build a new park, a student disagrees politely and listens to others. This shows...
A kindergartner wants to learn about community helpers. Which is a good picture source?
o: looking at photos of firefighters and teachers
looking at photos of random clouds

q: After a lesson on neighbors, a kindergartner can share learning by...
o: drawing a picture and telling about it
